members.name: _bindOptionI18n
members.description:
Keep an option's text translated. option.i18n is
{ context: <element using I18NMixin>, field: tKey, "value.name": tKey }
and fields are re-translated (and re-indexed) as that element's
translations load.

members.name: _resolveShortcutLabel
members.description:
Resolve a `shortcut` value on a defineOption into a display label via
the shared KeyboardShortcutManager registry. Accepts a registry id
string or an inline descriptor object. Returns "" when no label resolves
so the UI can treat absent/empty labels uniformly.

members.name: addVoiceCommand
members.description: allow uniform method of adding voice commands

members.name: _addVoiceCommand
members.description: event driven version

members.name: _toggleFromKeyboard
members.description:
The open / close shortcut. Closing goes through close() so every mode
(mini popover or full dialog) is torn down the same way it is from the
close button; only opening runs keyHandlerCallback, which picks the
mode and anchor. Flipping opened alone left a closed full Merlin set up
as a mini popover with no anchor, so the next open drew it in the top
left corner.

members.name: close
members.description: Close the modal and do some clean up

members.name: resetKonamiCode
members.description: Reset Konami Code sequence

members.name: checkKonamiCode
members.description: Check for Konami Code sequence

members.name: konamiCodeEntered
members.description: Handle successful Konami Code entry

members.name: _alignInlineField
members.description:
Inline mini Merlin (opened with / in an empty text block) is pulled up
over the block so its search field sits where the text was being typed.
A fixed pull-up can't know the block's line height or padding, so it
drew the field above the line; measure the real field and the real line
and move the popover by the difference.

members.name: _inlineLineCenter
members.description:
Vertical middle of the line the caret is on: the caret's own box when
the browser gives one, else (an empty block has none) the block's first
line from its padding and line height.

members.name: expand
members.description:
Move from the mini / wand popover to the full Merlin dialog, keeping
what has been typed, the context and any running program.

members.name: merlinSpeak
members.description:
Merlin says something: always as the Merlin speaking toast, so it can
be read with sound off or no speech support, and out loud when voice
is available. A missing hal-9000 (voice off) no longer throws, which
stopped whatever called this (cheat codes included) part way through.

members.name: _listenToHal
members.description:
Listen to what hal-9000 hears and reports about the microphone, once
per connection (a reconnect makes a new signal and listens again).

members.name: _voiceStateChanged
members.description:
The mic was refused, or this browser cannot recognize speech: stop
listening and say why. When speech is unavailable the mic button also
goes away for the rest of the session.

members.name: _refreshVoiceControls
members.description: Re-render every Merlin search box so the mic button can hide

members.name: _voiceVocabulary

Words so far, while someone is still talking. Only the card changes;

members.name: _showVoiceTip

A different tip each time listening starts, so people learn what

members.name: _voiceAfterRun
members.description:
A result ran by voice: stop listening unless it opened a program,
which takes spoken input next.

members.name: _voicePickAt
members.description: Run the result at an index in what is shown

members.name: _voiceRunItem
members.description: Run one item: show it alone and select it, as the keyboard would.

members.name: _voiceGrammar
members.description: A navigation phrase: pick, next, back, run, clear, cancel, help.

members.name: _voiceProgramInput
members.description:
Words for a running program. They go in the field like typing, and
Merlin keeps listening so the numbered results can be picked by voice.

members.name: _voiceHeard
members.description:
Final words that were not a fixed command. Spoken search, no AI:
1. a navigation phrase ("second one", "next", "run") acts on results
2. otherwise score every alternative against the commands here
   - high: one clear answer, run it
   - medium: likely answers, show them and ask
   - low: search with the words, so nothing is lost
Inside a program, the words are the program's input.

declarations.description:
A Metaphone-style sound key for a Latin-script word, so words that sound
alike match ("merlin" / "marilyn", "phone" / "fone"). Other scripts and
digits come back unchanged.

declarations.description:
Score heard words against one phrase, 0 to 1: how much of the phrase was
said (recall) balanced with how much of what was said is the phrase
(precision).

utterance only does the scoring.

True when this browser can both listen (SpeechRecognition) and speak

Icon names that mean Merlin. A Merlin control given one of these draws

goggles and idea bulb, in one ink (currentColor) with see-through
lenses. A Merlin control given one of these draws him inline so his bulb
and goggles can light: off at rest, on with hover or focus, glowing
while Merlin listens or works. Same shapes as hax:future-traveler-plain.

`super-daemon-toast`
Merlin's voice card in the HAX UI admin style: the Future Traveler mark,
a state pill (Listening, Speaking, Santa mode), the message, a hint of
what can be said, and a way to stop. Sits bottom left, apart from the
haxcms-toast that drops from the top bar.

events and every detail field (text, duration, merlin, future,

instance, so callers send nothing new.

members.name: _renderResultRow
members.description: Shared row template for mini (plain list) and full (lit-virtualizer).

members.name: _computeFiltered
members.description:
Keep each group's results together (Insert blocks, Site, ...), groups
ordered by their best-ranked result and results keeping their order
inside a group, so a heading never repeats. Programs and short lists
are left as they are.

members.name: _groupLabelAt
members.description:
Group label for the row at index i, shown only where the group changes
so a run of results reads as one section (Insert blocks, Site, ...).
Rows are not reordered, so keyboard order matches what is drawn.
Programs list their own results, so they are not grouped.

members.name: _resultsHover
members.description:
Hovering a row, or moving focus to it (arrow keys between rows), shows
it in the details pane.

members.name: _sameResults
members.description:
The filter recomputes on a debounce after the results it already
computed, giving a new list with the same results; that is not a new
search, so the highlight (keyboard or voice) stays.

members.name: voiceHighlight
members.description: Highlight a result without running it (spoken "did you mean").

members.name: voiceMove
members.description: Move the highlight by delta results, wrapping (spoken next / back).

members.name: voicePick
members.description: Run a result by index (spoken number or "run").

members.name: voiceSelectedIndex
members.description: The highlighted result index, or -1

members.name: _rowAt
members.description:
The row element for a result index, if it is rendered right now.
(Look up by data-row-index; the virtualizer only stamps visible rows.)

members.name: _selectAt
members.description:
Run the result at an index. A rendered row runs itself, as it always
has; the virtualizer only stamps rows that are on screen, so a result
scrolled out of view runs from its data, sending the same events a
row's selected() sends.

members.name: _updateActiveDescendant

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: The index of the selected item (-1 for none)

members.description: Update aria-activedescendant and manage selection state for accessibility

members.name: _applyActiveDescendantDom
members.description:
Apply active-descendant DOM state (row.active flags + scrolling) after
render. Split out from _updateActiveDescendant so updated() can reset
the DOM without setting reactive properties inside the update cycle.

members.name: _syncCombobox
members.description:
The focused search input is the combobox: it carries the role, whether
results are showing, which listbox it controls and which result is
highlighted. The input and the result rows live in different shadow
roots, so the rows are referenced as elements (ARIA element reflection
allows a reference into an enclosing shadow root); id references cannot
cross that boundary. Browsers without element reflection hear the
highlighted result through the #active-result live region instead.
